<style>
:root{
  --paper:#ECE7E1; --card:#F8F5F1; --stone:#CFC9C4; --line:#D9D2CB;

}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}

h1{font-size:1.45rem} h2{font-size:1.15rem} h3{font-size:1rem}
p{margin:0}

.tab{flex:1;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);padding:9px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer}

label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
input,select{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;width:100%}

.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy)}
.btn.sm{padding:6px 11px;font-size:.88rem}
#landing{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:var(--paper);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;padding:24px 22px;text-align:center;overflow:auto}
#landing[hidden]{display:none}
#landing .logo{width:120px;height:120px}
#landing h1{font-size:1.5rem}
#landing p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;max-width:330px}
#landing ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;line-height:2.1;color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
#landing .go{display:block;width:100%;max-width:330px;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;font-size:1.1rem;padding:15px;border-radius:14px}
#landing .skip{background:none;border:0;font:inherit;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline;padding:10px;cursor:pointer}
.game{margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line,#D9D2CB)}
.game h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1rem;color:var(--navy)}
.gcups{position:relative;height:150px;margin:14px auto 6px;width:100%;max-width:300px}
.gcup{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:30%;height:96px;transition:left .32s ease;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.gcup .lid{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;background:var(--navy);clip-path:polygon(8% 12%,92% 12%,80% 100%,20% 100%);border-radius:6px;transition:transform .3s ease}
.gcup .lid::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:4%;height:12%;background:var(--navy-2,#2C4670);border-radius:6px}
.gcup .lid::after{content:"R";position:absolute;inset:38% 0 0;color:#ECE7E1;font-weight:700;font-size:1.3rem;text-align:center}
.gcup .bean{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:6px;width:22px;height:30px;margin-left:-11px;background:#6B4226;border-radius:50%;transform:rotate(20deg);opacity:0}
.gcup .bean::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:45%;top:10%;bottom:10%;width:2px;background:#3B2314;border-radius:2px}
.gcup.has .bean{opacity:1}
.gcup.up .lid{transform:translateY(-58px)}
.gcup.win .lid{background:#1E7A4C}.gcup.lose .lid{background:#A8402F}
.gcups.busy .gcup{pointer-events:none}

.gtabs{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap}
.gtab{font:inherit;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.gtab.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
#gamesBox .gtabs{margin-top:0;padding-top:0;border-top:0}

.wgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;max-width:270px;margin:12px auto 8px}
.whole{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%,#E4D9CA 0 55%,#D6C8B5 56%);position:relative;cursor:pointer;padding:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.whole i{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:34%;height:46%;margin:-23% 0 0 -17%;border-radius:50%;background:#6B4226;transform:scale(0) rotate(20deg);transition:transform .14s ease-out}
.whole i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:46%;top:12%;bottom:12%;width:2px;background:rgb(0 0 0 / .35);border-radius:2px}
.whole.up i{transform:scale(1) rotate(20deg)}
.whole.gold i{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F3D58A,#B88A2E)}
.whole.burnt i{background:#1E1714}
.whole.hit{animation:hit .25s}

.wtime{height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--line);overflow:hidden;max-width:270px;margin:0 auto 6px}
.wtime i{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:var(--gold,#B08D57);border-radius:99px;transition:width .2s linear}
.woAns{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:48px;margin:10px 0}

.woAns span.f{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--navy)}

.woAns.no{animation:shake .35s}
@keyframes shake{25%{transform:translateX(6px)}75%{transform:translateX(-6px)}}
.woLet{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px}
.woLet button{font:inherit;width:44px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;border:0;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .18)}
.woLet button:disabled{opacity:.18;box-shadow:none}
.mgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;max-width:300px;margin:12px auto 4px}
.mcard{aspect-ratio:3/4;border:0;border-radius:10px;font-size:1.7rem;cursor:pointer;background:var(--navy);color:transparent;position:relative;transition:transform .25s,background .25s;padding:0}
.mcard::after{content:"R";position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#ECE7E1;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;font-family:inherit}
.mcard.open,.mcard.done{background:#fff;color:inherit;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);transform:rotateY(180deg) scaleX(-1)}
.mcard.open::after,.mcard.done::after{content:none}
.mcard.done{background:#E3F1E8;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #9BCBAE}
.qq{font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin:8px 0;line-height:1.7}
.qopts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-width:320px;margin:0 auto 6px}
.qopt{font:inherit;text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;cursor:pointer}
.qopt.ok{background:#1E7A4C;color:#fff;border-color:#1E7A4C}

.gbar{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:16px;font-size:.88rem;margin:6px 0 10px;color:var(--navy)}

.histBox:not([open]){gap:0}

.histBox .muted{font-weight:400;font-size:.85rem;opacity:.65;flex:1}
.linkBtn{font:inherit;font-size:.82rem;background:none;border:0;color:inherit;opacity:.6;text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;padding:6px}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end}
.row>*{flex:1 1 150px;min-width:0}
.note{font-size:.9rem;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px}
.note.err{background:var(--bad-soft);color:var(--bad)}
.note.ok{background:var(--ok-soft);color:var(--navy)}
[hidden]{display:none!important}

/* ============ تصميم Rya الفخم ============ */
:root{
  --paper:#F5F0E8; --card:#FFFDF9; --stone:#EAE2D6; --line:#E8DFD2;
  --navy:#16263F; --navy-2:#2A4168; --ink:#1D2330; --muted:#857C70;
  --gold:#B08D57; --gold-2:#D9BE8C; --gold-soft:#F4ECDF;
  --good:#2E7D5B; --bad:#A8453A; --bad-soft:#F7E6E2; --ok-soft:#EEF0F4;
  --h:"El Messiri","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",Tahoma,sans-serif;
  --sh:0 1px 2px rgb(40 30 15 / .04),0 10px 30px rgb(40 30 15 / .07);
}
body{background:radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 50% -200px,#FFFFFF 0,transparent 70%),var(--paper);background-attachment:fixed;letter-spacing:.1px}
h1,h2,h3,.histBox>summary,.mcat{font-family:var(--h);letter-spacing:0}
h1{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700} h2{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600}
.wrap{gap:20px;padding-top:28px}
.head{gap:10px}
.logo{box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--gold-2),0 0 0 7px var(--card),0 0 0 8px var(--line),0 14px 34px rgb(22 38 63 / .18)}
.head .badge{background:transparent!important;color:var(--gold)!important;border:1px solid var(--gold-2);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px}
.panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid rgb(232 223 210 / .7);border-radius:22px;padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.btn{border-radius:14px;padding:12px 18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1E3253,#16263F);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .12) inset,0 6px 16px rgb(22 38 63 / .18);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgb(22 38 63 / .18)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid var(--gold-2);box-shadow:none}
.btn.sm{border-radius:11px}
input,select,textarea{border-radius:14px;border-color:var(--line);background:#FFFEFC;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:0;border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgb(176 141 87 / .15)}

/* ============ لمسات Rya الأسطورية ============ */

   radial-gradient(420px 260px at 0 120%,rgb(42 65 104 / .95),transparent 70%),
   linear-gradient(160deg,#1D3355 0,#13213A 55%,#0D182A 100%)}
.head::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.07;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 25% 25%,#D9BE8C 1.2px,transparent 1.6px),radial-gradient(circle at 75% 75%,#D9BE8C 1.2px,transparent 1.6px);background-size:26px 26px}
.head::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:22px;width:120px;height:1px;margin-left:-60px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#D9BE8C,transparent)}

.head .badge{color:#E9D3A6!important;border-color:rgb(217 190 140 / .55)!important;background:rgb(217 190 140 / .08)!important}
/* ظهور ناعم للأقسام */
.wrap>section>*,#cCard>*{animation:rise .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
#cCard>*:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.06s}#cCard>*:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.12s}#cCard>*:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.18s}#cCard>*:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.24s}#cCard>*:nth-child(n+6){animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}}
/* لمعة على بطاقة الولاء */
.lcard{isolation:isolate}
.lcard>*{position:relative;z-index:1}

.feat:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}

/* عارض الصور */
#lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;background:rgb(10 16 28 / 0);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;transition:background .2s;backdrop-filter:blur(0)}

  $("ordToggle").onclick=function(){var t=this;t.disabled=true;call("adminSetOrdering",[PIN,!t.dataset.open],renderMenuAdmin,function(m){t.disabled=false;menuErr(m)})};
  $("payForm").onsubmit=function(e){e.preventDefault();var b=$("paySave");b.disabled=true;
    call("adminSetPayLink",[PIN,$("payLinkIn").value],function(r){b.disabled=false;$("payLinkIn").blur();renderMenuAdmin(r);b.textContent="تم الحفظ ✓";setTimeout(function(){b.textContent="حفظ الرابط"},2000)},function(m){b.disabled=false;menuErr(m)})};
}
function loadOffers(){call("adminListOffers",[PIN],renderAdminOffers,function(m){$("offList").innerHTML='<div class="empty">'+esc(m)+'</div>'})}
function offOk(t){var n=$("offErr");n.textContent=t;n.className="note ok";show(n,true);setTimeout(function(){show(n,false);n.className="note err"},4000)}
function renderAdminOffers(list){
  OFFERS_NOW=list.filter(function(o){return o.active&&!o.expired});updateWa();
  $("offList").innerHTML=list.length?list.map(function(o){
    var state=o.expired?"منتهي":(o.active?"فعّال":"موقوف");
    var col=o.expired||!o.active?"background:var(--line);color:var(--muted)":"background:var(--navy);color:#fff";
    return '<div class="item" data-o="'+esc(o.id)+'"><div class="grow"><div class="nm2">'+esc(o.title)+'</div><div class="sub">'+esc(o.details||"")+(o.ends?' · لين '+esc(fmtDate(o.ends)):'')+'</div></div>'+
      '<span class="badge" style="'+col+'">'+state+'</span>'+
      (o.expired||!o.active?'':'<button type="button" class="btn ghost sm" data-act="push" title="إرسال إشعار للجميع">📣 إشعار</button>')+
      (o.expired?'':'<button type="button" class="btn ghost sm" data-act="toggle" data-on="'+(o.active?0:1)+'">'+(o.active?"إيقاف":"تفعيل")+'</button>')+
      '<button type="button" class="btn ghost sm" data-act="del" style="color:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad)">حذف</button></div>'}).join(""):'<div class="empty">ما فيه عروض للحين. أضف أول عرض فوق.</div>';
}
var autoT=null;
function startAuto(){if(autoT)return;
  autoT=setInterval(function(){if(!document.hidden&&PIN&&!busy){search();loadSummary()}},15000);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",function(){if(!document.hidden&&PIN)search()});}
function search(){
  call("adminSearch",[PIN,$("q").value],function(list){
    var d=new Date();$("lastSync").textContent="آخر تحديث "+d.toLocaleTimeString("ar-SA-u-nu-latn",{hour:"numeric",minute:"2-digit"});
    $("aList").innerHTML=list.length?list.map(function(m){return '<button class="item'+(SEL===m.phone?" sel":"")+'" data-p="'+esc(m.phone)+'"><div class="grow"><div class="nm2">'+esc(m.name)+'</div><div class="sub ltr">'+esc(m.phone)+'</div></div>'+(m.hasPin?'':'<span class="badge" style="background:var(--line);color:var(--muted)">ما دخل بعد</span>')+'<span class="pts">'+fmt(m.points)+'</span></button>'}).join(""):'<div class="empty">'+($("q").value?"ما فيه نتائج.":"ما فيه عملاء بعد.")+'</div>';
  },function(m){$("aList").innerHTML='<div class="empty">'+esc(m)+'</div>'});
}
function openMember(phone){SEL=phone;show($("dMsg"),false);
  document.querySelectorAll("#aList [data-p]").forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle("sel",b.dataset.p===phone)});
  call("adminProfile",[PIN,phone],renderMember,function(m){msg(m,"err")});
}
function resetDel(){var b=$("delBtn");delete b.dataset.armed;b.textContent="حذف العميل";b.style.background=""}
function renderMember(p){
  if(p&&p.phone!==SEL)resetDel();
  if(p.notFound)return; SEL=p.phone; if(p.rewards){REW=p.rewards;fillRewards()}
  show($("detEmpty"),false);show($("detBody"),true);
  var tn=" "+tierFor(Math.max(p.points,p.peak||0),p.vip,p.legend).tag;$("dName").textContent=p.name+tn;$("dPinState").textContent=p.hasPin?"عنده رمز سري":"ما اختار رمز بعد";show($("pinReset"),!!p.hasPin);$("dPhone").textContent=p.phone;$("dBal").textContent=fmt(p.points);$("dSar").textContent="رصيد النقاط · "+sar(p.points)+" ريال";
  $("dLog").innerHTML=logHtml(p.history);
  CUR=p; updateWa(); resetUndo();
  if(window.innerWidth<760) $("det").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
}
function working(on){["doAdd","doRed"].forEach(function(id){var b=$(id);b.disabled=on;
  if(on){b.dataset.t=b.textContent;b.textContent="جارٍ الحفظ…"}else if(b.dataset.t){b.textContent=b.dataset.t}})}
function adjust(delta,note,done){
  if(busy||!SEL)return; busy=true; working(true);
  call("adminAdjust",[PIN,SEL,delta,note],function(p){busy=false;working(false);renderMember(p);done();search();loadSummary();
    msg((delta>0?"تمت إضافة ":"تم خصم ")+fmt(Math.abs(delta))+" نقطة. الرصيد الآن "+fmt(p.points)+".","ok");
  },function(m){busy=false;working(false);msg(m,"err")});
}
function msg(t,k){var n=$("dMsg");n.textContent=t;n.className="note "+k;show(n,true)}

MODE==="admin"?initAdmin():initCustomer();
</script>
